name: Renew My Space
source:
Our space is often a good reflection of us, as the items found hold stories and memories which offer insight into who we are as a person.

In Renew My Space, you help Lia reorganize her space filled with items are that represent Lia's dreams.

[From [url=https://chuastgrace.itch.io/renew-my-space]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们身处的空间往往能映照出自身。房间里的物品承载着故事与回忆，也让人得以窥见我们的为人。

在《Renew My Space》中，你将帮助Lia重新整理自己的空间。那里摆满了代表她梦想的物品。

[摘自[url=https://chuastgrace.itch.io/renew-my-space]Itch.io[/url]]
